title: First Light
description: The world explodes into brightness. You feel air rush into lungs that have never tasted air before — a shock, a burn, a scream that tears from somewhere deeper than thought. Warm hands that were once your whole universe now feel distant, small, gone. You are here. You are alone. You are.

outcomes.narration: Your voice fills the cold bright space. For a moment — nothing. Then movement, warmth, the familiar rhythm of a heartbeat against your cheek. Someone has heard you. You are not alone.

You watch the light shift and pool on surfaces you don't yet have names for. The cold is real. The brightness is real. Your silence is a small, strange defiance — a choice no one will ever know you made.
